text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: I'm home!!
text_block_list.orig_text: たっだいまー！！

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Iroha, you should go wash your hands and clean your teeth before you go relax.
text_block_list.orig_text:
イロハー
くつろぐ前に
手洗いとうがいしなさいよー

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: *sigh*... Seriously, Sono-san, give me a break... Could you please not rush me out to the grocery store first thing in the morning?
text_block_list.orig_text:
はあ……
まったく
ソノさん勘弁してよ……
朝っぱらから食品店に駆り出さないでくれる？

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: I can't help it, can I? The value egg pack deal is limited to three packs per person. Thanks to you two, I was able to buy nine packs in total. Nice.
text_block_list.orig_text:
しょうがないでしょ？
たまごのお値打ち品
お一人様３パックまでなんだもん。
あんたらのおかげで
９パック買えたわ。
ナイス。

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: "Nice", as if. I was up all night yesterday, and you woke me up all of a sudden. *yawn*... I'm so sleepy...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ナイス
じゃないわよ。
昨日徹夜だったのにいきなりたたき起こされたんだから。
ふわぁ……
眠……

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: Heehee... However it was worth it... thanks to that, my secret elixir is finally complete.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふ……
でも
その甲斐あって、
例の秘薬、
ついに完成しちゃったわよ。

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: A secret elixir... is it for something shameless? Like that book under your bed, Lou-chan.
text_block_list.orig_text:
例の秘薬って、
破廉恥な薬ー？
ルイちゃんのベッドの下にある本みたいな。

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: What's that?! Wait, Iroha-chan, you're peeking under other people's beds too much!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんでよ！！
ってか
イロハちゃん人のベッドの下覗きすぎだから！

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: W-Well, we'll talk more about my secret elixir later. Hey, Sono-san, was this actually fine?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ま、
まあ秘薬の話は後でたっぷりするとして。
ねえソノさん、
大丈夫なの？

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: I mean, isn't today the day that one-day manager comes? So was it okay that we went out like that?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほら、
今日は一日店長が来る日なんじゃないの？
外出しちゃってよかったわけ？

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: That's right, it's today, isn't it!? Miyama the Stag Beetle is coming!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうだ、
今日だったよね！？
【クワガタ】のミヤマちゃんが来てくれるの！！

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: That's completely different. She's called Nozomi from Carmina. ...Oh crap, we totally flew past the appointed time. I was overcome by the magic of bargain eggs sales and completely forgot about it...
text_block_list.orig_text:
全然違うわ。
【カルミナ】のノゾミちゃんね。
……
やっば、
約束の時間過ぎちゃってる。
特売たまごの魔力に負けて
完全に忘れてた……

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: What should I do? She might have gone home because she thought we weren't around...? I have to contact the Guild Management Association right away...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
どうしよ、
留守だと思って
帰っちゃったかも……？
急いでギルド管理協会に連絡入れないと……！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: *clatter*...!!
text_block_list.orig_text: ガタッ……！！

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: I heard a sound coming from Lou's alchemy lab! Let's go check it out!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ルイちゃんの工房の方から音がしたよ！
行ってみよ！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: After that...
text_block_list.orig_text: そして──

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: Ohhhh!?
text_block_list.orig_text: おお～っ！？

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: ...No, no.
text_block_list.orig_text: ……いやいや。

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.orig_text: はあ……っ！？

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: *sniff sniff*... haa...! You smell so good... hafuu...♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
クンクン……
はぁ……っ！
いい匂い……
はふぅ……っ♪

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: H-Hey, hey, HEY! What are you planning doing SHAMELESS things in my sacred alchemy lab?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょ、
ちょっとちょっとちょっと！！
人の神聖な工房で、
なに破廉恥なことしてんのよ～っ！！？

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: I-I don't care for your reason right now, you're being shameless, perverted! I mean, just get away from each other already...
text_block_list.orig_text:
わけもなにも、
どこからどう見ても破廉恥なんですけどっ！？
ってか
いい加減離れなさいって……

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: ...Hm? Lou-chan, what's wrong?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ん？
ルイちゃん、
どした？

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: You're my... Destined Prince!?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あなたは
私の……
運命の王子さまっ！？

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Huh?!
text_block_list.orig_text: えっ！？

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Is this the kind of cliched encounter where they bumped into each other around a corner...? And now that same prince is here with a popular idol on top of him... I can't quite wrap my head around it... Hey, Lou-chan?
text_block_list.orig_text:
この子が角でぶつかったってベタな出会いの……？
その王子さまが、
今ここで人気アイドルと……
ちょっと理解が追い付かないけど……
って、
ルイちゃん？

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: ...How dare you trample on my maiden heart and first love...!  I WILL NEVER FORGIVE YOU!! I WILL TURN EVERYTHING TO DUST!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
よくも
私の乙女心と初恋を踏みにじったわね……！
許さないんだから！！
全て塵に帰してやるわ～っ！！

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: Whoa!! That's a very good villainous line! But more importantly, Lou-chan, isn't it dangerous to set a bomb on fire in this room?
text_block_list.orig_text:
わー！！　
悪役っぽいセリフ！
それよりルイちゃん、
部屋の中で爆弾に火付けたら危ないよ～？

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: How dangerous...! No, I mean, we're going to die!! Everyone, hurry up and get outside!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
危ないよ～
じゃなくて死ぬわっ！！
みんな早く外に出て！！

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: DORYAAAHHHHHHH!!
text_block_list.orig_text: どりゃあ～～っ！！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: BOOOOOOMMMM!!!
text_block_list.orig_text: ドガァァァーーーン！！！

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Cough, cough...! ...Huh?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ゲホ、
ゲホ……！
…………
あれ？

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: What's going on here...? Why is the store exploding? I mean, what have I been doing up until now...
text_block_list.orig_text:
これ、
どういう状況……？
何でお店が爆発してるの？
っていうか、
私今まで何を──

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Back to normal...? Now that I think about it, just now while I was in the store, I suddenly... became very aware of the smells around me. And you smelled really good...
text_block_list.orig_text:
元に……？　
そういえばさっき、
お店の中で急に……
まわりの匂いがすごくよく分かるようになって。
それに、
すごくいい匂いで……

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Your scent makes me lose my sense of reason...
text_block_list.orig_text:
キミの匂いに、
理性が吹っ飛んで……

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Actually I... did I do something to you after that...? I feel like I did something terrible...
text_block_list.orig_text:
っていうか私、
キミに何かしちゃった……？
なんか
とんでもないことをしちゃった気がするんだけど……

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Yeah. All I know is that I felt happy. Maybe right now I can't smell you because of the leftovers from this bomb blast, so that's why I can stay calm...
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん。
幸せな気持ちになったことだけしか分からない。
今は多分
この爆風でキミの匂いを感じないから、
冷静でいられるのかも……

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: HEEEEEEEEEY YOU!! JUST GIVE UP AND DIE ALREADYYYY!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
こらぁ～～！！
観念して
いっぺん死んできなさ～いっ！！

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Whaaat?!
text_block_list.orig_text: えええっ！？

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: Whoaaaa! A barrage of bombs!! That's such a villainous special attack move!
text_block_list.orig_text:
わー！
爆弾乱れ打ちだ！！
悪者っぽい必殺技ーっ！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: *Swish swish swish swish*!
text_block_list.orig_text: ザシュザシュザシュッ！

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: He cut all the bombs fuses...?! H-He's so cool! That's my Prince in action! ...Wait, that's not it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
導火線を斬った……！？
かっ、
かっこいい、
さすが王子さま。
……
じゃないわっ！

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: ...No, you're in trouble, boy. It's true that you prevented the bomb from igniting, but...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……いや、
やばいよ
君。
確かに爆弾の着火は防いだけどさ……

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: Wow, that swordplay just now... You're not shabby at all.
text_block_list.orig_text:
へえ、
今の剣術。
なかなかやるね。

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: Onii-chan you seem to love swordplay. Iroha also loves it! I really, REALLY, love it! So...
text_block_list.orig_text:
おにーちゃん
剣術好きなんだ。
イロハも大好き！　
大・
大・
大好き！　
だから。

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: When it comes to swordsmanship... I won't be beaten by ANYONE!!
text_block_list.orig_text: 剣なら誰にも負けないんだッ！！

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Even if you've prevented the bombs from igniting. Aww, it seems Iroha's fighting spirit has exploded instead...
text_block_list.orig_text:
爆弾の着火は防いでも。
あーあ、
イロハの闘志に火が付いちゃったよ……

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: Let's GO! Take THIS!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いっくよー！
そらぁーっ！！

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Wait, what's even happening right now...? How did this even come to pass just because I wanted to buy some eggs? My brain is refusing to understand... I'm just sluggish and I want to lie down...
text_block_list.orig_text:
てか
何だこの状況……
たまご買いに行っただけで
こんなことある？
脳が
理解を拒否してる……
だるい
横になりたい。

text_block_list.text: Fufufu! It would be a waste to lie down right now! The best part of this festival has just begun, hasn't it?☆
text_block_list.orig_text:
フフッ！　
横になるなどもったいないっ！
最高の祭りが始まってるじゃあないか☆

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Huh...?
text_block_list.orig_text: えっ……？

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: HAHAHAHAHA! There, there, there~!! Onii-chan, you're slowing down!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
はははっ！　
そらそらそらぁ～っ！！
おにーちゃん、
スピードが鈍ってるよ！！

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: TIME-TO-FINISH-THIS!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
と・
ど・
めー！！

text_block_list.text: HAAAAH! Injection!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
はああっ！
インジェクション！！

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: ...Whoa!?
text_block_list.orig_text: ──っとぉ！？

text_block_list.name: Christina
text_block_list.text: Oh? I may have been holding back, but you still managed to parry my attack. You seem to be quite skilled. This is... making my heart dance...☆
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほう？
手加減したとはいえ
ワタシの一撃をいなすとは。
中々の手練れのようだな。
これは……
心が躍るぞ……☆

text_block_list.name: Christina
text_block_list.text: Hahaha. I had nothing better to do, so I came to check on Nozomi and it seems like she's having a great time. Well then, I'll have to take part in this fun aswell!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ハハハ。
暇だったんで
ちょっとノゾミの様子を見に来たら、
随分な大盛り上がりだな。
さて、
ワタシも愉しませてもらおうかっ！！

text_block_list.name: Christina
text_block_list.text: NUMBERS AVALON!!!
text_block_list.orig_text: 乱数聖域ッ！！！

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: KYAAAAA...!?
text_block_list.orig_text: きゃああ～～っ！？

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: The group was quickly subdued by Christina's intrusion. Somehow everyone managed to regain their composure...
text_block_list.orig_text:
クリスティーナの乱入によってあっという間に制圧された一同。
何とか落ち着きを取り戻し──

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: ...Alright, let's try this again. You're Nozomi-chan, the one-day manager we asked for. I'm Sono, the owner of Alkes Alchemist Hall.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……じゃあ
改めて。
あなた、
一日店長で来てくれた
ノゾミちゃん
だよね。
私はアルケス錬金堂の店主、
ソノです。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Anyway, first apologies are in order here. I'm sorry for our unruly alchemist coming at you all of a sudden. Come on, Lou-chan, lower your head.
text_block_list.orig_text:
とにかく
まずは謝らないと。
うちの錬金術師が
急に
ごめんなさいね。
ほら、
ルイちゃんも頭下げて。

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: ……Hmph.
text_block_list.orig_text: ……ふん。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: U-Umm... I should be the one apologizing for entering your alchemy lab without permission.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
あの……
こちらこそ、
無断であなたの工房に入ってごめんなさい。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: It's all our fault for forgetting about today and going shopping, so don't worry about it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
これに関しては、
今日のことを忘れて
買い物に出ちゃった
うちらが全面的に悪いから、
気にしないで。

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: ...You're forgiven.
text_block_list.orig_text: ……あなたは許す。

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: So easy.
text_block_list.orig_text: ちょろっ。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: I'm just fine, hm...!?
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん、
大丈──
……っ！？

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: W-Wait...! Don't come any closer to me...! If you get any closer, I'll probably...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ま、
待って……！
これ以上私に近寄らないで……！
これ以上近寄られたら、
多分また……

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Ah... Eggs. If you don't put them in the fridge, they'll rot.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ……
たまご。
冷蔵庫に入れないと腐っちゃいますよ。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: ...! Oh, that's right, I left them laying around just like that, didn't I? Those special bargain eggs. ...Huh? But why?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……っ！
ああそうだ、
そのままにしてたね
特売たまご。
……え、
でも
なんで？

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: Yeah, yeah... How did you know that we bought eggs?! Nozomi-chan could it be that you can use psychic powers?! Wow, Iroha wants to have them too!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うんうん……
なんでたまごのことわかったの！？
もしかしてノゾミちゃん
超能力使えちゃうのかな！？
すごーい、
イロハもやりたーいっ！

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: I don't have such powers... Umm, you see... I just smelled them.
text_block_list.orig_text:
使えませんよ……
えとね。
匂いがしたから。

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: ...You smelled them? Eggs? Don't be ridiculous. There's no way you could smell eggs that are in a different room.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……匂い？　
たまごの？　
ふざけないでよ。
違う部屋に置いてあるたまごの匂いなんて、
感じるわけないわ。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: ...True enough... I wonder what's wrong with my body... or rather, my nose. It really is strange after all...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……だよね
……どうしちゃったんだろう？
私の体……
というか、
鼻。
やっぱりおかしいよ……

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: ...Wait a minute. It's not here.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ちょっと待って。
無い。

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: You guys, do you know something about the elixir I left right there?! It's rainbow-colored and has a label on it...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あなたたち、
ここに置いてあった
薬知らない！？
虹色に光ってて、
ラベルが貼ってある……

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: Your memory is so amazing, how wonderful♪ ...No, wait a second!
text_block_list.orig_text:
記憶力すごい、
すてき♪
……
じゃなくて！

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Ah, that famous secret elixir you stayed up all night making? No, wait, No. 568... So you've failed 567 times already?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ、
徹夜で作ったって
例の秘薬？
ってか
No.568って……
これまで567回失敗重ねてんのか。

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: Those weren't failures. They were all successes... In their own ways, they just had different results than expected.
text_block_list.orig_text:
失敗じゃないわ。
成功したのよ。
ただ、
思ってたのと違う効果が出ちゃうってだけで。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: That's what society normally calls a failure.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それを失敗というのよ
世間では。

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: ...Anyway, where did you even put my secret elixir?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
それよりその秘薬、
どこにやったの！？

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Ah, well... If I recall, when I was holding that bottle, my foot got caught in a book and I fell, so it must've landed on the floor...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ、
えっと……
確か瓶を持った時に、
本に足を取られて転んじゃって、
そのまま床に……

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: ...HAAAAA?! It's all broken!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ああ！？
ちょ、
割れちゃってるじゃない！？

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: Mm, you're forgiven then... Wait! Don't tell me you both drank this!?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん、
許す……
じゃなくて！
その症状、
もしかして。
あなた
これ飲んじゃったんじゃない！？

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: I-I didn't drink it. Now that I think about it, I do have a slight bitter taste in my mouth right now...
text_block_list.orig_text:
の、
飲んでなんかないよ。
そういえば、
今
口の中にちょっとだけ苦みがあるけど……

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: SO YOU DID DRINK IT!!
text_block_list.orig_text: 飲んでんじゃないのよ！！

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: *sniff sniff*...
text_block_list.orig_text:
クン、
クンクン……っ。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: ...Lou-chan, did you make an elixir that makes one more sensitive to smells?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ルイちゃん、
匂いに敏感になる薬でも作ったん？

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: No... This is... a secret elixir to "release your true self".
text_block_list.orig_text:
違う……
これは、
『本当の自分を解放する秘薬』なの。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: A secret elixir to "release your true self"...? The real myself... It can't be.
text_block_list.orig_text:
『本当の自分を解放する秘薬』……？
本当の自分……
まさか。

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: If you have any idea of what's going on, don't try to hide it. We need to know everything to get a good grasp of the elixir's effects.
text_block_list.orig_text:
心当たりがあるなら
隠さず話して。
薬の効果、
ちゃんと把握しないといけないから。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: ...Understood
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
分かった。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: I've been hiding this ever since I became an idol... I haven't told anyone except Chika and Tsumugi. Not even the Producer... not even you, {0}.
text_block_list.orig_text:
このことはアイドルになってから、
ずっと隠してて……
チカとツムギ以外の人には誰にも言ってない。
プロデューサーにも……
キミにも、
ね。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: ...Actually I... I've been sensitive to smells since I was little... I love them, I can't stand them, they're supreme... Whenever I smell the scent I love, I don't feel like I want to move...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……実は私、
小さい頃から匂いに敏感というか……
大好きというか、
たまらないというか、
至高というか……
もう
好きな匂いを嗅いだまま動きたくないというか……

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: In other words...
text_block_list.orig_text: つまり……

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Nozomi confessed that she's always been a smell fetishist. Such a revelation would greatly affect the fates of both Nozomi and the Alkes Alchemy Hall.
text_block_list.orig_text:
自分は匂いフェチだと告白したノゾミ。
このことが、ノゾミと【アルケス錬金堂】の運命を
大きく変えていく──

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: Ehehe~, Iroha likes strong people~♪ Hey, let's play by pretending to fight again! Wouldn't that be great, Big Sis Chris?
text_block_list.orig_text:
えへへ～、
イロハ強い人好き～♪
ねー
もう一回戦いごっこしよ！
いいでしょ、クリスおねーちゃん！

text_block_list.name: Christina
text_block_list.text: Argh! Don't hug me! It's too hot! ...More importantly, Big Sis Chris, you say? You... you're about my age, aren't you?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ええいっ！　
抱きつくな暑苦しいっ！
……
それより、
クリスおねーちゃんだと？
オマエ、
ワタシと同い年くらいだろう？

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: W-Well, we'll talk about that at a later date, okay.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ま、
まあ
その話は
後日、
おいおい、
ね。

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: All right then, let's GO!
text_block_list.orig_text:
それじゃ、
いっくよー！
